description: The saved weekly content plan for your own product, if one has been generated (see generate_content_plan). Read-only and free even when a plan exists — generating a new one is the paid step. Returns plan: null when none has been made yet. No cost to call. Use when the user asks to see the content plan already generated for their product.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.

name: get_content_plan

plan.description: null when no plan has been generated yet.

title: Get Content Plan
